generalSection.descriptionP1: Professional full-stack developer, UX/UI expert, graphic designer, and an engineer at heart with years of experience crafting software solutions for Industry 4.0.
generalSection.descriptionP2: Balance is key. I blend two seemingly opposite skill sets—technical expertise and creative design—to deliver well-rounded, innovative solutions.
generalSection.descriptionP3: A good product shouldn't just work—it should feel intuitive and enjoyable to use.
generalSection.englishTooltip: Officially, my level is B2, but I feel very comfortable communicating in English. I've been using English to talk with international friends for years. I also rely on it for most of my tech research and learning—to access more information, discover new vocabulary, and keep practicing consistently

upna.title: Software Engineering Graduate (2023)
upna.description: I carried out multiple complex projects that allowed me to learn and take my first steps into the professional world. During my final year of university, I completed my internship at Zeo Technology while working on my final degree project, the Report Wizard. This remains my main project: a tool that allows users to generate and edit reports intuitively. It features an interface with a wide range of options and a simplified design that includes conveniences like drag and drop. It adapts to users of different skill levels. It is a living and evolving project to this day.

zeo.description:
Company dedicated to Industry 4.0, with international recognition in the sector (Spain, China, Mexico, Germany, Brazil...). Its main product is an MES system. After 1 year of internship, I began working as a full-stack developer.
Main projects and tasks:
zeo.reportWizard: Report Wizard, well received by clients worldwide, constantly improving and expanding, with features such as customizable charts
zeo.components: Library of editable components, based on PrimeNg, adapted to the company's aesthetics and functionality
zeo.filters: Dynamic filtering system, editable from the application, based on the components from the previous point
zeo.planner: Automatic and scheduled email report sending, configurable by the user via a simple interface
zeo.general: Creation, modification, testing, documentation, and maintenance of other general sections of the application

allIn.description:
Design, UX/UI, and front-end development have always caught my attention. Although I work as a full-stack developer using Angular daily, I felt the need to dive deeper into these areas.

All in is my personal website, which I have also used to learn React and the other skills I’ve always been interested in, related to design and UX/UI, using online resources to train myself.

personalSection.personalText1:
It's always good to know who you're working with...
So, this section is more personal:

Made in Ukraine and raised in the south of Navarre, I have a bit of both worlds. Now I live with a leopard gecko and a dozen Amazonian fish in Pamplona.
personalSection.personalText2:
I have two sides: one intense, carefree, and energetic; the other responsible, committed, and professional. The key is knowing which one to bring out at the right time.

At the same time, I enjoy both the traditional and the modern, the natural and the urban, the calm and the intense, the technical and the creative...

Madrid or the Pyrenees? Programming or design? At home or partying in Budapest? A walk in the mountains or motocross?

There's always some project to work on: development, design, repairs, botany, 3D printing, painting... Growing and learning matter. Special mention to motor-related: mechanics, cars, motorcycles...

I have a unique way of approaching things, and I’ve learned to make the most of it. I like to think big and act strategically.

There are many more philosophical topics we can discuss at some corporate event; networking matters.

aheadSection.aheadText1: Now that we know each other a bit better, it's time to talk about the present and, above all, the future
aheadSection.aheadText2: I have to say that I am very happy to have done my internship and started my professional career at Zeo Technology. A great team, with remarkable camaraderie and cutting-edge methodologies. I enjoy the projects that are developed and the technologies that are used. The vast majority of my knowledge and skills I have acquired here.
aheadSection.aheadText4: Unfortunately, there are two important points that make me consider a change:
aheadSection.aheadText5: On one hand, what I love most about the IT world is mixing the creative side with the technical side. In a company focused on data and industrial clients, the creative aspect takes a backseat, focusing on handling large amounts of data and efficiency.
aheadSection.aheadText6: On the other hand, many of my future plans require time and mobility. Although there is an option for remote work here, the truth is that it is very limited. I am not against going to the office, but I want to do so with the freedom of choice, so I am looking for something in a hybrid or remote model.
